healing.name: Healing Draught

text.throw: Heals you if you stand in the splash

healing.lore: Moss steeped in grave-water until it remembers being green. The sextons kept a flask of it under every bell.

mana.name: Mana Tonic

text.throw: Foes in the splash lose their next attack

mana.lore: Blue, faintly humming, and colder than it should be. The novices drank it to stay awake through the vigil.

liquidEmber.name: Liquid Ember

text.throw: A pool of fire for 5 seconds

liquidEmber.lore: Salt from the braziers, ground with bone and stoppered hot. The cork is always scorched.

frostbrew.name: Frostbrew

text.drink: No chill takes you, and you move faster, for 20 seconds
text.throw: Freezes everything in the splash for 2 seconds

frostbrew.lore: Rimewater and a breath of light. It frosts the glass from the inside.

bottledStorm.name: Bottled Storm

text.throw: A lightning storm on the splash for 3 seconds

bottledStorm.lore: It knocks against the glass when thunder is near. Never shake it.

echoes.name: Philter of Echoes

text.throw: Foes in the splash strike each other

echoes.lore: A choirmaster's last breath, they say, taken in a bell jar. Speak near it and it answers.

giants.name: Giant's Brew

text.drink: Bigger, half again as strong and a little slower, for a room
text.throw: Foes in the splash grow slower and bigger

giants.lore: Bone dust, twice over. It thickens the blood and the bones with it.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep Tincture

text.drink: Foes lose track of you for 4 seconds
text.throw: A cloud of darkness: foes inside can't aim

shadowstep.lore: It drinks the candlelight from the room it is opened in.

bitterRemedy.name: Bitter Remedy

text.drink: Your newest curse takes no price until the floor ends
text.throw: Clears every status in the splash

bitterRemedy.lore: Burnt moss and salt. Nobody drinks it twice by choice.

volatile.name: Volatile Mixture
volatile.lore: What a failed brew becomes. It changes colour when it is not watched.

hexBrew.name: Hex Brew

text.drink: Your hands and feet go the wrong way for 5 seconds
text.throw: Foes in the splash are hexed

hexBrew.lore: A curse with a cork in it. Thrown, it remembers whose curse it is.

graveDraught.name: Grave Draught

text.drink: Half a heart for a pale soul mote
text.throw: A skeleton rises to fight for you this room

graveDraught.lore: Moss and bone from the same grave. What drinks it is a little more dead; what it is spilled on, a little less.

graveMoss.name: Grave Moss
graveMoss.lore: It grows only where something was buried with care.

wispEssence.name: Wisp Essence
wispEssence.lore: The light a creature of light leaves behind. It is warm, and wants to rise.

boneDust.name: Bone Dust
boneDust.lore: Ground from the old dead, who no longer need it, and the stone things that walk.

emberSalt.name: Ember Salt
emberSalt.lore: The crust that forms on a brazier's rim, and in the cinders of things that burned.

rimewater.name: Rimewater
rimewater.lore: Water that froze and would not thaw. It stays cold in a closed hand.

wardensAsh.name: Warden's Ash
wardensAsh.lore: What is left when a guardian of the vault falls. It is heavier than ash should be.
